items.title: When Evidence Changes the Question
items.topic: how new evidence can reveal that a policy debate was framed too narrowly
items.topicJa: 新しい証拠によって政策論争の問い自体が狭すぎたと分かる場合
items.benefit: clear questions help researchers compare options and gather relevant evidence efficiently
items.benefitJa: 明確な問いは選択肢を比較し必要な証拠を効率よく集める助けになること
items.challenge: a fixed question can hide assumptions about goals, affected groups, time horizons, and which outcomes deserve measurement
items.challengeJa: 固定された問いは目的、影響を受ける集団、時間軸、測るべき成果についての前提を隠すこと
items.lesson: strong reasoning sometimes requires revising the question rather than merely collecting more answers to the original one
items.lessonJa: 優れた推論には元の問いへの答えを増やすだけでなく問いそのものを見直すことが必要

items.title: The Politics of What Gets Counted
items.topic: how measurement choices influence which social problems become visible and actionable
items.topicJa: 何を測るかという選択が社会問題の見え方と政策対応に与える影響
items.benefit: standard indicators allow comparisons across time and places and can reveal persistent inequalities
items.benefitJa: 標準指標は時期や地域を越えた比較を可能にし長期的な格差を示せること
items.challenge: important experiences that are difficult to quantify may receive less attention, while measured outcomes can dominate budgets and incentives
items.challengeJa: 数値化しにくい重要な経験は注目されにくく測定された成果が予算や動機づけを支配すること
items.lesson: measurement is not neutral; responsible systems examine both what indicators reveal and what they leave outside the frame
items.lessonJa: 測定は中立ではなく指標が示すものと枠外に残すものの両方を見る必要がある

items.title: Efficiency, Fairness, and the Last Ten Percent
items.topic: why serving the hardest-to-reach users can cost much more than serving the majority
items.topicJa: 最も届きにくい利用者へのサービスが多数派より高コストになる理由
items.benefit: standardized systems can deliver services cheaply and quickly to large numbers of people
items.benefitJa: 標準化された仕組みは多数の人に低コストで迅速にサービスを届けられること
items.challenge: remote locations, disabilities, language barriers, unstable schedules, or unusual needs can make the final group much more expensive to serve
items.challengeJa: 遠隔地、障害、言語、変則的な時間、特殊な必要によって最後の集団への提供費用が高くなること
items.lesson: judging a public service only by average cost can reward exclusion; fairness may require deliberately spending more where access is hardest
items.lessonJa: 平均費用だけの評価は排除を促す可能性があり公平性には届きにくい場所へ意図的に多く使うことも必要

items.title: Why Accurate Predictions Can Still Produce Bad Policy
items.topic: the difference between predicting an outcome accurately and deciding what society should do about it
items.topicJa: 結果を正確に予測することと社会が何をすべきか決めることの違い
items.benefit: reliable predictions can help governments prepare resources, identify risks, and compare likely consequences
items.benefitJa: 信頼できる予測は資源準備、リスク発見、結果比較に役立つこと
items.challenge: prediction alone cannot determine acceptable risk, rights, fairness, priorities, or how errors should be distributed among groups
items.challengeJa: 予測だけでは許容できるリスク、権利、公平性、優先順位、誤りを誰が負うかは決められないこと
items.lesson: evidence can inform policy choices without replacing the ethical and political judgments those choices require
items.lessonJa: 証拠は政策判断を支えられるが必要な倫理的・政治的判断そのものを置き換えることはできない
